subject: food-technology

moments.title: EU 14 allergens regulation
moments.body: Regulation (EU) 1169/2011 requires labelling of 14 specified allergens in pre-packed and unpackaged food.
moments.takeaway: Standard allergen lists became a regulatory feature.

moments.title: Death of Natasha Ednan-Laperouse
moments.body: Natasha dies after eating a baguette without clear sesame labelling.

moments.title: Natasha's Law
moments.body: Pre-packed for direct sale food now requires full ingredient and allergen labelling.
moments.takeaway: Bereaved families have driven food labelling change.

now.title: Allergens now
now.body: Allergy prevalence is rising; oral immunotherapy is reaching clinical use.
now.open_questions: Can food labelling keep up with personalised dietary needs?

reflection: Food labels carry life-and-death information for some shoppers.
